reviews.author: Toria Moylan
reviews.text:
If you are thinking about booking the Grace for your wedding, we couldn’t recommend it more. We got married at the Grace Hotel in October 2026 and it was perfect from start to finish.  Lauren, the wedding coordinator and her team could not have done more for us, they made the whole process so enjoyable, stress free and genuinely fun. Lauren brought the most calming energy and the day couldn’t have gone smoother, all thanks to them. They have their systems down to a tee. The food was exceptional across the board, the staff were so warm and professional and the venue itself is so stunning.

Tadgh, the operations manager was brilliant and so welcoming and made us feel right at home.

Michael in reservations was amazing too, helping coordinate our guests accommodation.

Dylan at the concierge was so helpful and such a friendly face.

All of our guests couldn’t get over the standard of hospitality at the Grace and can not wait to go back.
We are delighted we chose the Grace, it exceeded our

reviews.author: Eleanor Ash
reviews.text: Just had a lovely night in The Grace, great location and beautiful room. Food in Kelly's was amazing and breakfast in the restaurant was top tier. The best thing about the hotel is the staff, all great at their jobs but Oisín, Dylan and Breda made the stay especially memorable. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Laura Fee
reviews.text: Thank you Breda from The Black Sheep restaurant for your amazing service, you are fantastic!! We will definitely be back! - Dr Laura Fee

reviews.author: Wander778809
reviews.title: A lovely weekend away at the Grace Hotel in Westport.
reviews.text:
Myself and my husband stayed at the Grace recently. 
The hotel is beautifully designed and decorated and felt very warm and comfortable. 
Our room was lovely and spacious and the bathroom was very large and clean. 
We ate both in the restaurant and in the bar and the food was excellent in both. The staff were efficient and friendly in all areas of the hotel. 
A trip to the spa is a must also. I would highly recommend it. 
The hotel itself is incredibly well situated. It is only a 10 min  walk into the town centre for a little retail therapy or a visit to one of the very many pubs for some music and craic. 
Overall a really relaxing stay and I look forward to staying there again soon!

reviews.author: Ciara Jolly
reviews.text:
We attended a wedding here over the weekend and WOW the entire place every single detail you can tell is hand picked, whoever is in charge of the decor take a bow it was unreal.
Even down to the uniforms the staff wore every little thing all tied together the staff were so friendly and the man who came out with an umbrella to the car in the storm what a hero , our room was huge and absolutely beautiful the little touches the water and coffee left and the gorgeous “ground” range for the bathrooms absolutely love this stuff.
Didn’t get to the spa unfortunately but I heard it was also amazing which I don’t doubt.
The food at the wedding was amazing so so nice , but the breakfast the next morning I’m telling you now is probably the best breakfast spread I have ever seen or had it was outstanding!
We so enjoyed our stay and will definitely be returning an absolute gem in the west.

reviews.author: Andrew Kirby
reviews.text: We had our wedding here in October 2026. It was perfect - service, venue, staff, food, all were exceptional.

reviews.author: knahs
reviews.title: No air conditioning in hotel room
reviews.text: Very nice hotel (especially the breakfast buffet).  Room was clean but could not get it cool enough.  They did supply a fan which helped some but, at least for me, I did not sleep well because the room was too hot.  They indicated there is no air conditioning.

reviews.author: Niluka Vidyarathne
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel. Staff were very friendly. Breakfast was Fabulous 👌

reviews.author: aadrienner
reviews.title: Ten out of ten 👏👏👏
reviews.text:
A perfect experience on every level. Mary set the tone on arrival with her warm friendly smile and her obvious pride in The Grace. 
Our room was very comfortable, well appointed , spacious and cosy. 
Lunch was excellent, Mansa looked after us so well. Also at dinner she preempted our every need. Food was delicious, a wonderful experience on every level. 
Then there was Breeda at breakfast.. what a wonderful friendly and competent host. She is truly passionate about her job and it shows. 
We had a fabulous time… thank you.

We’ll be back.

reviews.author: John Hayes
reviews.text: Great hotel. Stayed for a three day mid week break and couldn’t fault it. Lovely staff, great food, nice room. Breakfast was particularly good

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.text: A thoughtful, seamless experience from check in to breakfast to departure. A lovely place to rest from a long day of travel, near to the Cliffs of Moher.

reviews.author: EimerDo
reviews.title: This hotel gives exceptional customer service
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel but what makes it stand out for my friends and I when we visited is their customer service.  Their friendliness without it being either OTT or just polished  is exceptional.  Nothing is a problem and yet they all have a sense of fun - seem happy in their jobs  no matter the role.  The spa, swimming pool etc gorgeous.  The bedroom standard very high quality.

reviews.author: martinnR7604ZE
reviews.title: Night staff was exceptional
reviews.text: Great hotel comfortable and good value the service was exceptional, everyone went beyond their duty to ensure guests had a great experience, Kevin (night sfift was excellent he went above and  beyond  to ensure everything was perfect a great team member) hopefully we will be back in the no to distance future to enjoy the luxury of our experience .

reviews.author: vilmag851
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The service was honestly the best we’ve ever experienced in a hotel. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything was just perfect, and we couldn’t have asked for more. We’d highly recommend this hotel and would love to come back! ❤️

reviews.author: 593louisam
reviews.title: our experience did not match the instagram page And impressive marketing campaign
reviews.text: Lovely hotel, felt the actual hotel does not match the extravagant way it’s marketed on social media, it’s an old hotel that’s been given a modern facelift. It’s not in the Westport estate which the marketing campaign would lead you to think, the estate is sadly is closed for works so you can’t even walk around any grounds, we were disappointed when we realised we were staying just off the road and not even in the estate. Staff were nice however we were met with a really rude household staff member when we asked where the spa was she said “I don’t know the sign says Downstairs” I think if your trying to create a luxury hotel every staff encounter with staff should be positive. The food was great and definitely a highlight. Great night away but would say don’t be led by impressive social media campaign our experience did not match the instagram page!!

reviews.author: 491mauricec
reviews.title: 5 star possibly exaggerated
reviews.text: 3 nights B&B with evening meal, lovely hotel, beautiful decor, bedroom ensuite was exceptional with individual heat controls which was great because the hotel lobby and dining room were very cold, excellent breakfast buffet, very friendly efficient staff, reception team very welcoming. I would however question 5 star rating, possibly 4 star max. Spa/pool facilities were excellent except jacuzzi not functioning for the 4 days, staff need additional training in the food service area regarding menu contents, they had to keep going back to check what was included etc., I ate in Black Sheep one night where extra charges applied to my package for items on the menu, this should have been noted when ordering, side orders are extra. No main dinner menu and overall an expensive menu, not a 5 star experience. Food in the Kelly bar on the remaining nights was very good but again staff need to know the menu. I noticed on my second day that full payment was taken from my card, which is noted on the

reviews.author: Carolyn Cox
reviews.text: We were on a tour and stayed there two days. Our second night there I got sick and was unable to leave with my group. The hotel was so kind as to let me stay until that afternoon, called to check on how I was feeling and also called a taxi so I could meet up with my travel group at the next hotel. Impeccable  service.

reviews.author: Yuliia Yemchenko
reviews.text: I stayed at The Grace for a couple of nights and absolutely loved it! The rooms were cosy, spotless, and beautifully comfortable. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and both the restaurant and the bar were fantastic! Everything made the stay feel special and relaxing. I had such a wonderful experience and can’t wait to come back! Highly recommend!✨

reviews.author: GracyGalway
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: The Grace Hotel, Westport - a fabulous experience from arrival to departure! We were celebrating our 20th wedding anniversary, it was such a treat with lots of special touches, from the card and cake in our room to the personable greetings we got from all the staff. Martin on reception, Breda in the restaurant, all the staff are so professional and go out of their way to ensure a 5 star experience, well done all, can’t wait to go back. X

reviews.author: Ocean Retreat
reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful stay at The Grace in Westport, visiting for a family wedding, and cannot recommend the hotel highly enough.

From the moment we arrived, the staff were exceptional. Nothing was ever too much trouble, and every interaction felt genuinely warm, thoughtful and generous. It’s rare to come across a team who go so far out of their way to make your stay special.

The newly refurbished interiors are absolutely beautiful. As an interior designer, I tend to notice the finer details, and I was genuinely impressed by the quality of the finishes, the considered design choices and the attention to detail throughout. It is a beautiful refurbishment, and it is clear that an enormous amount of thought and care has gone into every aspect.

We also asked the hotel to arrange a babysitter for our children, and Beatrice was absolutely marvellous. She made such a lovely impression on the children, even bringing them a little gift, and settled them into bed so we could enjoy the wed

reviews.author: Kathagena
reviews.text: We were redirected here by chance and had a wonderful stay. We were already on our way to Westport when our originally booked hotel called to cancel our reservation. However, they had booked us a replacement at The Grace, which is nearby. In retrospect, we were lucky, as we absolutely loved it. The light lunch and breakfast were excellent. The staff were exceptionally attentive and friendly! This really stood out to us. From the receptionists to the bellboys, the cleaning staff, the waiters, etc. – everyone was fantastic!

reviews.author: Romy Dunford
reviews.text: We were just at an amazing wedding. The food and location were incredible - but what stood out the most was the staff, namely Malachi. We were so well looked after and the service was outstanding. What a gorgeous experience?! Thank you to The Grace

reviews.author: Anna Kuzmina
reviews.text: Very vibey place🥰

reviews.author: Relax249380
reviews.title: Almost there
reviews.text:
I appreciate that The Grace is newly opened but there are areas they could have spotted and improved by now. Some staff are inexperienced which impacts the guests experience of the hotel. For example constantly asking if we are having a good day. Nice first time but annoying being asked repeatedly. Outside and the interior are tastefully done. My room was spotless and well equipped. I wasn’t able to get the coffee machine working. I gave up after many attempts. The pod would not drop down. I was leaving at that point. 
Breakfast was disappointing. I found the staff weren’t as attentive as I would expect. I had to leave my breakfast to ask for toast while servers were close by and not busy. The Buffet breakfast was disappointing. Ingredients were good, unfortunately they were lukewarm which I find unappetising. A €5 surcharge for French toast and two other items ( which I can’t remember at this moment) on the menu is a bit much considering the B&B rate for the hotel. One lucky find was

reviews.author: roisins2017
reviews.title: Exquisite.
reviews.text: Arriving at the Grace Hotel we were greeted by a very helpful Man and two lovely  Receptionists . We were shown to a gorgeous room by the Man who also carried our suitcase. The inside of this Hotel is truely  magnificent. So clean and tastefully decorated and l have to say that all members of the staff  were so polite and helpful. Breakfast is a feast and there was more than enough and choice for everyone.  One little thing l would like to point out is this. Beautiful hotel can’t wait to return again , thanks very much for a fab weekend .

reviews.author: Summer Browne
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning! With perfect cocktails.

Wonderful atmosphere. Dave greeted us on arrival. We started with a fabulous cocktail and then went on to have a meal in Kelly’s. 
Rodrigo was one of the servers who looked after us. But all staff were very polite and kind.

reviews.author: V4226JSjohnk
reviews.title: Fourth Stop
reviews.text: Our fourth stop on our tour.  This is a nice newer hotel downtown.  Walking to shops, restaurants and pubs. I had ordered wine to celebrate our anniversary and had to remind staff.  They were apologetic and waived the charges.  Great food, bar, and service.  Room was very nice.

reviews.author: Ebony
reviews.text: Beautiful property and lovely staff.

reviews.author: H7392MKkevink
reviews.title: Eager to return
reviews.text: We loved this hotel.  The food is wonderful, and so are the rooms.  The staff was very attentive and helpful, including about my curiosity regarding which whiskey I should try.  I had a particular problem caused by my own carelessness.  The hotel staff went out of their way to fix it, and they made it happen.  It was top shelf customer service.  The room was spotless and comfortable.  The town of Westport is great, and we hope to return.  If we do, there is no question about where we will stay.

reviews.author: Matiss
reviews.text:
My stay at The Grace was enjoyable. The sauna and pool facilities were excellent, and the staff were friendly. I particularly enjoyed the steak, and the breakfast offered a great variety of options.
I'll be back.

reviews.author: tracygX4107SV
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel & Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic 2 night stay and honestly couldn’t fault it. The spa treatment (restorative ritual) with Kate was one of the best I’ve ever had — she was amazing and made the experience so relaxing. It was definitely the highlight of the stay. 
The food in Kelly’s Bar was absolutely delicious, and the atmosphere throughout the hotel was so calm and relaxing. Breakfast was outstanding, with so much choice and everything beautifully presented.
The hotel itself is immaculate, which is no surprise as it’s brand new. The staff were all extremely friendly, welcoming and helpful, which really added to our stay.
The hotel is very conveniently located less than 5 mins walk to the centre of westport.  
Overall, a beautiful hotel with fantastic food, wonderful staff and a lovely relaxing atmosphere. We will definitely be back! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: X7447UFmaurod
reviews.title: A loverly place where relex
reviews.text: I stayed there for three days while on a business trip. It was lovely to experience the welcoming, elegant and warm Irish atmosphere. I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: A Mc
reviews.text:
We recently got married at The Grace and have stayed there once previously and cannot recommend it enough.

From the very beginning of the planning process right through to our wedding day, the team at The Grace could not have done more for us. We had around 150 guests, and almost everyone commented on how beautiful the hotel was and, more importantly, how incredible the staff were. From the breakfast team and bartenders to the receptionists, spa staff and wedding team, every single person went above and beyond to make everyone feel welcome. It was real Irish hospitality at its finest.

The hotel itself and the events space are absolutely stunning, set within beautiful woodland surroundings. It provided the most perfect backdrop for our wedding, and so many of our guests were visiting Westport for the first time. They all left saying how much they loved it and how keen they were to return.

Hopefully, we'll have the chance to return to The Grace for another wedding in the future! ❤️

reviews.author: alecbromley
reviews.title: The Spa was wonderful
reviews.text:
We stayed for 3 nights at the Grace Hotel. We had a wonderful time, the room was comfortable and clean. We made use of the Spa too.

Great friendly staff. We're already looking forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: Ciara reilly
reviews.text:
Lovely experience recently at the Grace for a wedding. Staff were friendly and helpful. They helped accommodate an early check-in for us. The hotel is very well located, an easy stroll into Westport. Breakfast and food was great.

The wellness suite is a really lovely experience. Would stay again!

reviews.author: John Keaveney
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel with extremely friendly staff and amazing food. We were really well looked after by the whole team at the Grace for our wedding. A huge thanks to Mary, Ciaran and Lauren who couldn't have done more to make sure all our guests had a great time and were well looked after. We cant wait to come back!

reviews.author: Sparklyprincess29
reviews.title: Exceptional Experience

David was warm, charming, professional and incredibly attentive. You can tell he takes enormous pride in both the hotel and the experience he provides to his guests.

I also have to give a very special mention to Rodrigo and Carlos, who were simply fantastic. They were polite, extremely well-mannered, attentive and so helpful throughout the evening. What made them stand out even more was their wonderful sense of humour and friendly personalities. They managed to provide impeccable service while also making us laugh and feel

reviews.author: Aron Moran
reviews.text: Absolutely lovely venue and the steak I had down in the restaurant was perfect.

reviews.author: Lauren Marie
reviews.text: We were only here for one night but this was our favorite stop during our recent trip in Ireland. This property is top-notch in every regard - the rooms are beautiful and clean, the service is friendly and helpful and the breakfast is plentiful and delicious. We loved being able to walk into town and we wish we had more time to spend in the area. I'd definitely return to The Grace and I'd highly recommend it to anyone that plans on spending time in Westport.

reviews.author: Karen Burke
reviews.text: A beautiful experience from start to finish. The room was lovely, warm and very comfortable with everything at hand. The food was outstanding, as was the wine (we ate in the bar).  Staff are excellent.  They're a credit to themselves and the Senior Management in The Grace.  We're really looking forward to going again soon! Its exactly was we needed in the hospitality sector in County Mayo.

reviews.text: Enjoyed three nights in a very comfortable room which was spotless as were the communal areas. Dairy and gluten free breakfasts not a problem. Looking forward to returning when the grounds of Westport House are fully open again. Would highly recommended The Grace. Madeleine

reviews.author: pierreaZ5182PI
reviews.title: Not what we expected...
reviews.text:
We had heard about the recent opening of The Grace and booked 2 nights during our September road trip across Ireland. From the dreamy imagery and enticing descriptions on the website, I was imagining a luxury boutique accommodation set in an idyllic oasis of nature.

Reality was unfortunately very different and it is beyond me how The Grace is listed as member of the exclusive Small Luxury Hotel collection.

From the exterior, The Grace has the charm of an airport hotel, a large building entirely surrounded by a parking lot. Once inside, the experience is definitely more refined and elegant, however it's very dark, as there is very little natural sunlight.

We had booked one of the Clew Bay suites and the room was large, well equipped and tastefully decorated. However, when you open the curtains, the large windows offer no other view than… the parking lot!  But the worst part was to come: the sound proofing was terrible and we had the constant noise of footsteps, voices and slamming do

reviews.author: danielmF2690EQ
reviews.title: Best hotel around Westport
reviews.text:
The Grace Hotel is hands down the best hotel I've stayed in around Ireland. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment you arrive.

The housekeeping team are probably the best I've encountered at any hotel — genuinely attentive. They even come round in the evening to turn down the bed and leave a pillow spray to help you sleep. Little touches like that make a real difference.

The breakfast buffet is also up there as the best I've had anywhere. I didn't manage to get into the Black Sheep restaurant as it was fully booked, so I'd definitely recommend booking that in advance if you're visiting. That said, the food in Kelly's Bar was excellent and a bit easier to grab a table.

The location is great too — a short walk into Westport, but far enough that you can skip driving in and dealing with the traffic.

All in all, a fantastic stay and I'd highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Eymard Brennan
reviews.text: Have no words to describe our stay in the Grace is was just amazing,one of the best if not the best hotel we have ever stayed in.A warm welcome staff could not be more helpful,food was fantastic  and the breakfast just something else.5 stars all the way highly recommended you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: johnsF2265EC
reviews.title: September break
reviews.text: We spent 5 nights at the Grace,commencing on 6th September. The staff and food were excellent.However we did not get off to an auspicious start.After a 4/5 hour drive we arrived at 3.15 pm. We were told that our room was not ready, understandable as check in is not until 4pm. However despite several requests we did not get in to our room until 5.30pm.Reception or the member of staff who helped with our luggage could not provide an explanation for the long delay. We did receive an apology at the time,but it is slightly disappointing that we had to pay for our cup of coffee whilst we endured the long wait.It would have been a nice gesture to have had a complimentary coffee.

reviews.author: tinacB3849OI
reviews.title: 5 Stars

reviews.author: B1638CNlauram
reviews.title: We Can’t Wait to Come Back.
reviews.text:
We had the best time staying at The Grace Westport! From the moment we checked in to the moment we checked out, everything - and every person was just fantastic.

A special shout-out to Mary, who made us feel so welcome and went above and beyond to make our stay so enjoyable. Breakfast was absolutely fantastic too!

We would fully recommend The Grace and can’t wait to return. We had such a lovely stay! ❤️

reviews.author: clairedL2792GG
reviews.title: Top class
reviews.text: We finished off our trip to Ireland in Westport and stayed at The Grace. What a perfect way to end our trip! Beautiful hotel, great atmosphere and wonderful staff. A special mention to Ciaran, whose pride in the hotel really shows and made us feel so welcome. We loved Westport and couldn’t have picked a better place to finish an unforgettable trip to Ireland.

reviews.author: Amy Arduini
reviews.text: On the lovely, lush, green Isle Of Ire. I had the pleasure of staying with friends to witness the Union of Brianne and Chris.  With an amazing vibrant floral grounds, beautiful scenery and doting staff members. Shout out to all the staff who tended our wedding,  but especially Adrian and Svetlana. Also the bar tender who's name I unfortunately did not catch.  Who never let us go without hydration and quickly tended to our every reasonable request throughout the night.  Would 100% recommend this hotel to my American family and friends if they ever visit Ireland. Can't speak higher of my experience.

reviews.author: D6332QAgeraldines
reviews.title: A wonderful experience from morning to night!
reviews.text: We stayed at The Grace from August 23rd through the 26th. What a wonderful stay we had! The rooms were clean, comfortable and had everything we needed! We enjoyed the great food from  our Sunday dinner in the comfort of the cozy Kelly’s bar to our special night at The Black Sheep! The service on Monday night at The Black Sheep was great from Emma who helped us choose a wine and to David who couldn’t do enough for us! The food was excellent ( we especially loved our scallops and the pork belly appetizers!!). We also enjoyed a night cap at the lovely cocktail bar. We can’t talk about food without mentioning the best breakfast we have had on our travels which has included Ireland, Italy and Switzerland! The sausage rolls were a favorite as was the Irish Brown Soda Bread!!! Breda who was doing hostess duty was professional, friendly and working hard to seat everyone in a timely manner on a busy morning! She was even handing out the Brown Bread recipe from the chef with great detail to all

reviews.author: Claire Jackson
reviews.text:
As a non resident visited the Grace for breakfast this morning. It was to.mark a special birthday so the budget stretched to 26 euro per person
The staff were helpful, friendly and numerous. The buffet was extensive and continuously replenished and the provision of gluten friendly options was unusually impressive

reviews.author: Faye Cusack
reviews.text: We had the most amazing stay at the Grace. We stayed for a birthday celebration and the staff could not have been more brilliant. We will definitely be back

reviews.author: Emily O Reilly
reviews.text:
A fabulous experience. From the moment we walked in the door. My partner and I  really could not get over how friendly and attentive the staff were. The room was immaculate and the dining was superb. The buffet breakfast was well controlled, constantly restocked, clean and fresh. They had lots of fancy homemade pasteries like almond croissants, cinnamon swirls, apple strudels etc that I thought was a really lovely touch. The pool area was very clean with no wet floors so it was nice to walk around - it was evident the cleaners were also there regularly as even the public showers and surrounding was very clean and tidy.
Another thing we loved beyond the perfect location of the hotel, was the live music in the evening and the very knowledgeable (& friendly) mixtoglist working behind the bar - so plenty of entertainment in the evening!

We loved it so much, we booked to stay again at the check out (which we have never done before)!

A shoutout to chef Martin for the fabulous meal and birt
